metadata.scope: M28X YNU outdoor graph with M30X representative indoor template entry mapping for Chenggong Campus gates, main-road waypoints, core POI, search/place/catering targets, and single/multi-route demo targets.
coordinate_sources: Yunnan University public campus context around Chenggong Campus, Kunming
M28X manual Chenggong-Campus axis estimates for gates, road waypoints, core POI, services, catering, dormitory, and restroom access nodes
needs_review: Road geometries use endpoint fallback lines until a later offline OSM geometry stage.
Indoor templates are M30X reusable demo data, not verified real interior surveys.
Coordinates are manual Chenggong-Campus axis estimates and should be checked before cartographic use.
metadata.indoor_scope: M30X YNU representative indoor templates and gate_link entry mapping; no real indoor survey data.

nearby_profiles.notes: 图书馆查附近优先命中借阅、咨询和自习支持服务。
教学楼群查附近优先展示教学服务台、学习角和教师支持空间。
学生食堂查附近优先命中取餐、调料和自助回收等就餐配套服务。
北侧学生宿舍区查附近优先命中便利补给点，贴合宿舍生活区的日常购物动线。
东区学生公寓查附近优先命中学生事务、行政与创新服务节点，贴合东侧生活学习复合片区。
中心广场查附近优先展示图书馆咖啡和轻食点，贴合广场停留后的轻餐饮需求。
南门查附近优先命中体育馆和田径场，贴合南侧入校后直达运动片区的动线。
体育馆查附近优先展示更衣、训练和观赛等运动设施。
